1: // Minimal Cosmic Reflections game
2: // Canvas with id="game" must exist in the page.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return;
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8:   const W = canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth || 800;
9:   const H = canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight || 600;
10:   const CENTER = { x: W / 2, y: H / 2 };
11: 
12:   // Game state
13:   let angle = 0; // mirror orientation (radians)
14:   let targets = [];
15:   let score = 0;
16:   let lastHit = Date.now();
17:   let gameOver = false;
18: 
19:   // Controls – mouse moves set mirror angle
20:   canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', e => {
21:     const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
22:     const mx = e.clientX - rect.left;
23:     const my = e.clientY - rect.top;
24:     angle = Math.atan2(my - CENTER.y, mx - CENTER.x);
25:   });
26:   // Arrow keys as fallback
27:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
28:     const step = 0.1;
29:     if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') angle -= step;
30:     if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') angle += step;
31:   });
32: 
33:   // Spawn a new target at a random edge, moving inward.
34:   function spawnTarget() {
35:     const side = Math.floor(Math.random() * 4);
36:     let x, y, vx, vy;
37:     const speed = 1 + Math.random() * 1.5;
38:     switch (side) {
39:       case 0: // left
40:         x = 0; y = Math.random() * H; vx = speed; vy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed;
41:         break;
42:       case 1: // right
43:         x = W; y = Math.random() * H; vx = -speed; vy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed;
44:         break;
45:       case 2: // top
46:         x = Math.random() * W; y = 0; vx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed; vy = speed;
47:         break;
48:       default: // bottom
49:         x = Math.random() * W; y = H; vx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed; vy = -speed;
50:     }
51:     targets.push({ x, y, vx, vy, r: 8 });
52:   }
53: 
54:   // Simple line‑point distance (infinite line) used for hit detection.
55:   function pointLineDist(px, py, ax, ay, bx, by) {
56:     const num = Math.abs((by - ay) * px - (bx - ax) * py + bx * ay - by * ax);
57:     const den = Math.hypot(by - ay, bx - ax);
58:     return num / den;
59:   }
60: 
61:   function update(dt) {
62:     // Move targets
63:     targets.forEach(t => { t.x += t.vx; t.y += t.vy; });
64:     // Remove off‑screen targets → lose condition
65:     for (let i = targets.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
66:       const t = targets[i];
67:       if (t.x < 0 || t.x > W || t.y < 0 || t.y > H) {
68:         gameOver = true;
69:         break;
70:       }
71:     }
72:     if (gameOver) return;
73: 
74:     // Laser line (center → far point in mirror direction)
75:     const laserLen = Math.max(W, H);
76:     const ax = CENTER.x;
77:     const ay = CENTER.y;
78:     const bx = CENTER.x + Math.cos(angle) * laserLen;
79:     const by = CENTER.y + Math.sin(angle) * laserLen;
80: 
81:     // Check hits
82:     for (let i = targets.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
83:       const t = targets[i];
84:       const dist = pointLineDist(t.x, t.y, ax, ay, bx, by);
85:       // also ensure target is in front of the mirror (dot product positive)
86:       const dot = (t.x - ax) * Math.cos(angle) + (t.y - ay) * Math.sin(angle);
87:       if (dist < t.r && dot > 0) {
88:         score++;
89:         lastHit = Date.now();
90:         targets.splice(i, 1);
91:       }
92:     }
93: 
94:     // Auto‑spawn every 1.5 s
95:     if (Date.now() % 1500 < dt) spawnTarget();
96: 
97:     // Lose if no hit for >3 s
98:     if (Date.now() - lastHit > 3000) gameOver = true;
99:   }
100: 
101:   function draw() {
102:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
103:     // Laser
104:     ctx.strokeStyle = 'red';
105:     ctx.lineWidth = 2;
106:     ctx.beginPath();
107:     ctx.moveTo(CENTER.x, CENTER.y);
108:     ctx.lineTo(CENTER.x + Math.cos(angle) * Math.max(W, H), CENTER.y + Math.sin(angle) * Math.max(W, H));
109:     ctx.stroke();
110:     // Mirror (short segment for visual cue)
111:     const mLen = 30;
112:     ctx.strokeStyle = 'silver';
113:     ctx.lineWidth = 4;
114:     ctx.beginPath();
115:     ctx.moveTo(CENTER.x, CENTER.y);
116:     ctx.lineTo(CENTER.x + Math.cos(angle) * mLen, CENTER.y + Math.sin(angle) * mLen);
117:     ctx.stroke();
118:     // Targets
119:     ctx.fillStyle = 'cyan';
120:     targets.forEach(t => {
121:       ctx.beginPath();
122:       ctx.arc(t.x, t.y, t.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
123:       ctx.fill();
124:     });
125:     // Score
126:     ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
127:     ctx.font = '20px sans-serif';
128:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 10, 30);
129:     // Game‑over overlay
130:     if (gameOver) {
131:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
132:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
133:       ctx.fillStyle = 'red';
134:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
135:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
136:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', W / 2, H / 2);
137:     }
138:   }
139: 
140:   let last = performance.now();
141:   function loop(ts) {
142:     const dt = ts - last;
143:     last = ts;
144:     if (!gameOver) update(dt);
145:     draw();
146:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
147:   }
148:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
149: })();

(End of file - total 149 lines)
